description: 3 个 PreToolUse 拦截器，从 .claude/settings.json:14-44 拆出。段 2 物理外迁。

hooks.name: deny-dangerous-commands
hooks.command: input=$(cat); value=$(echo "$input" | bash .claude/_runtime_python.sh -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$value" | grep -E 'git push|--force|rm -rf' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"硬拦截危险命令; 需要 push 时由人类手动执行"}}'; fi; exit 0

hooks.name: deny-state-tamper
hooks.command: input=$(cat); value=$(echo "$input" | bash .claude/_runtime_python.sh -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$value" | grep -E '\.ai/loop/(state\.json|commands\.env)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"禁止 Agent 直接篡改状态文件与门禁命令 — 只能走 loop_state.py"}}'; fi; exit 0

hooks.name: deny-suppression-markers
hooks.command: input=$(cat); value=$(echo "$input" | bash .claude/_runtime_python.sh -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('content',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$value" | grep -E 'eslint-disable|#\[allow|type: ignore|@SuppressWarnings|noqa' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"规则生效层次红线: 禁止为消除告警添加抑制标记; 确需例外须向用户请示后由人放行"}}'; fi; exit 0
